upstreamFrontmatter.name: humanizer
upstreamFrontmatter.description:
Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says.
Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line
closers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, sales
language, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing."

adaptations: Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Consolidated entry point; primary resources retained and variants namespaced without overwrites.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
